# dist/ — release snapshots

`RavenEngine-0.1.0-linux-x86_64.tar.gz` — Linux x86_64 snapshot of RavenEngine 0.1.0 (commit `5463ddd`).

Contents: `raven_tests` (37/37 — built without system Vulkan, renderer disabled), static
engine libraries, public headers (`engine/include`), sample project, compiled SPIR-V
shaders, `docs/` (incl. `PERFORMANCE.md`), `scripts/` (`perf_budget.py`, SBOM generator),
`third_party/manifest.json`.

Why this lives in git: release **asset uploads** (`uploads.github.com`) are not reachable
from the automated environment used to cut this snapshot, so the binary artifact is
committed here instead (~1.9 MB). It is a snapshot, not a build cache — `build/` itself
remains git-ignored and is regenerated by CMake on every clone.
